353:t_1:86.en:
$$シモン$$
「But we threw that kind of common sense away a long time ago.」

353:t_1:88.en:
$$タケル$$
「Where there's hope, light is born. Let's fight and never forget that.」

353:t_1:89.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I-I know that... It's just their hard work and guts that I can't keep up with.」

353:t_1:90.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Aw, I get it! So you're one of $c too, $$ラルク$$!」

353:t_1:91.en:
$$バサラ$$
「So your heart's on fire too, huh.」

353:t_1:92.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That kind of thing... isn't my style...」

353:t_1:93.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But we don't have much time left...」

353:t_1:94.en:
$$刹那$$
「Our enemies aren't only the $$サイデリアル$$ on Earth. They're in outer space too.」

353:t_1:95.en:
$$桂$$
「$$バアル$$, huh... Just thinking about it gets me down.」

353:t_1:96.en:
$$モーム$$
「You can't say that, $$桂$$! Everyone's all fired up!」

353:t_1:97.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now then, $$万丈$$... I think it's time you let us hear it.」

353:t_1:99.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A man of your caliber is serving as the MC of this briefing, after all.」

353:t_1:100.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Surely you've prepared some trump card to turn this around... or at least a lead?」

353:t_1:101.en:
$$万丈$$
「...As expected of you, $$ロジャー$$. You saw through even that much.」

353:t_1:103.en:
$$万丈$$
「...The whereabouts of the outer-space mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$, which the $$サイデリアル$$ seized, have been found.」

353:t_1:105.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「If we can take it back...」

353:t_1:106.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That means we can get 《$$ヴェーダ$$》 back!」

353:t_1:107.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$ヴェーダ$$, the best quantum computation system on Earth...」

353:t_1:108.en:
$$刹那$$
「With that power, we might even be able to devise a strategy to stand against the Empire.」

353:t_1:109.en:
$$シン$$
「Then let's hurry up and take it back!」

353:t_1:112.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We searched for where $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ went by every means we had too, but we couldn't find even a clue...」

353:t_1:113.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$万丈$$... Tell me where that information came from.」

353:t_1:114.en:
$$万丈$$
「Your concern is perfectly reasonable, $$スメラギ$$. That's exactly why I wanted to handle this information carefully.」

353:t_1:115.en:
$$万丈$$
「The one who brought me this information is someone from $$クロノ$$.」

353:t_1:117.en:
$$シン$$
「The mysterious organization that has interfered in humanity's history from the shadows...」

353:t_1:118.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If they came to cooperate with us, are they one of the Reformists?」

353:t_1:119.en:
$$万丈$$
「The $$クロノ$$ Conservatives, who monitor humanity's evolution, and the $$クロノ$$ Reformists, who watch over humanity's evolution...」

353:t_1:120.en:
$$万丈$$
「She contacted me while I was working to uncover what $$クロノ$$ really is, and she said she was neither of those.」

353:t_1:121.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So a third $$クロノ$$, then...」

353:t_1:122.en:
$$桂$$
「You said 'she,' but was it a woman?」

353:t_1:123.en:
$$万丈$$
「We never spoke directly. It's just that she called herself '$$クィーン$$.'」

353:t_1:124.en:
$$マオ$$
「Something like a code name, huh...」

353:t_1:125.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, it's not a code a man would go by.」

353:t_1:126.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What matters is that this is information that could even decide the course of the war from here on.」

353:t_1:127.en:
$$万丈$$
「The coordinates I was given are on the outskirts of the $$地球圏$$, a place with nothing around it.」

353:t_1:128.en:
$$万丈$$
「As for how credible it is, I can't say anything myself.」

353:t_1:129.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You mean it could be a trap...?」

353:t_1:130.en:
$$万丈$$
「It could just as well be the truth.」

353:t_1:131.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then it's settled. Let's go.」

353:t_1:133.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We're at rock bottom right now. If we can't fall any further, we should bet on even the slimmest chance.」

353:t_1:135.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So do I. It's worth the risk.」

353:t_1:137.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The battles ahead of us will be a succession of hardships like none we have faced before.」

353:t_1:138.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Superior or subordinate, soldier or civilian, it makes no difference. No matter whose opinion it is, we will take it up as a comrade's.」

353:t_1:139.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I will ask again. Does anyone object?」

353:t_1:142.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「What will we do if it turns out to be a trap?」

353:t_1:144.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We survive no matter what... to keep hope alive.」

353:t_1:145.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Understood, Miss $$スメラギ$$. I will throw in with that strong will of yours.」

353:t_1:146.en:
$$シモン$$
「Looks like no one's against it.」

353:t_1:147.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Same as ever, a bunch with a screw loose somewhere.」

353:t_1:148.en:
$$ノノ$$
「N-no way! Something's wrong with $$ノノ$$'s head parts!?」

353:t_1:149.en:
$$モーム$$
「$$ノノ$$! It might be me!」

353:t_1:150.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「You two... that's not what he meant.」

353:t_1:151.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「With this, everyone's will is unified. All that's left is to get it done.」

353:t_1:152.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Attention, all hands. As soon as we arrive at the $$地球圏$$, we will begin the operation to retake $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

353:t_1:153.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We make this battle the first step of our counterattack...! All hands, steel yourselves!」

353:t_1:154.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(If we retake $$ヴェーダ$$, we might find out...)

353:t_1:155.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(The relationship between $$クロノ$$, $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$... and $$エルガン・ローディック$$...)

353:t_2:4.en:
$$フェルト$$
「...We've received reports from every team that boarded $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$. No dangerous items or traps of any kind were found.」

353:t_2:5.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Looks like the Empire withdrew in a big panic.」

353:t_2:6.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「I guess our showing up was something they never expected.」

353:t_2:7.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Their absolute trust in Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ may have delayed their planning for a contingency.」

353:t_2:8.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「But that $$ストラウス$$... She's the Supreme Commander of the Imperial forces, yet she went out of her way to come and intercept $c, right?」

353:t_2:9.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「The war on Earth is pretty much settled. She probably came to crush us, the last nuisance.」

353:t_2:10.en:
$$フェルト$$
「After that, I think she was aiming for the $$スフィア$$s of $n, $$クロウ$$, and the others.」

353:t_2:11.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Maybe she's just a figurehead Supreme Commander who made it to the top brass because she happens to hold a surprising number of $$スフィア$$s.」
